title: Workflow route removals (plan §1.2/§1.5/§2l)
description: Shape of workflow-route-removals-v1.json. A removed route requires source evidence, rationale, a surfaceKind classification, and a verifier that fails if it returns — scripts/verifyWorkflowRoutes.mjs re-fails any removal whose commandId reappears in the live registration scan. A removal classified surfaceKind: "userFacingContribution" (a package.json contributes.commands/menu entry) additionally requires an approvedScopeDecision recording explicit human approval before it can ship — removing user-facing product surface is a higher class of change than an internal route removal and is never authorized by a review score alone (plan §2l).
